focus_areas: Fur texture realism vs. painterly smoothing
Boundary separation between tail and background grass
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the weasel's fur and the surrounding grass. AI generators often struggle with fine hair details against complex backgrounds, leading to 'melted' edges. Verify that the short legs are anatomically plausible and not just suggested by shadows. Ensure the elongated body does not exhibit impossible curvature or spinal discontinuities. Prioritize the output of the open_vocabulary_detector to ensure the topology audit has accurate spatial grounding.
image_description: A small, elongated mustelid (weasel/ferret) standing in green grass. The animal has reddish-brown fur on its back and head, with lighter cream/white fur on its underside and neck. It is looking upwards to the left. The tail is visible extending to the right. The image has a slightly soft, painterly quality.
